editorialView.undatedHanson: A dated capture is a dated witness of an undated work, not an undated later copy. Exact timestamp, Memento and matching hash support attestation no later than 2000-08-19 and retain G01/G03/G09. This does not establish 1998 wording, the earliest capture anywhere, or journal publication.
editorialView.g04g05: Keep a mechanism distinction: G04 concerns incomplete/slow automation and complementary remaining tasks; G05 concerns residual resources, natural time, regulation or preferences after broad substitution. Slow diffusion can involve both. Use specific residual-constraint passages; Clancy’s selected cumulative record is mixed context. A merged constraint proposition with mechanism types is preferable to pretending this record provides a clean boundary.
editorialView.g09: Store each author’s rate definition, duration, horizon measured from the text date, and conditional/unconditional probability separately. Do not convert verbal non-exclusion into a numerical >=10% claim or treat about-century and 100-plus horizons as sharp opposition. Opposite debate positions may share a plausibility relation under this criterion; do not use it to assign forecast camps.
editorialView.g06: The criterion says no sign, whereas Nordhaus reports two positive tests and an overall not-near judgment. If the intended proposition is no persuasive evidence of a near-term approach, revise its wording and then reassess. Under the present literal wording his record bears on it.
